The source points to a specific tagged release on the project's official GitHub repository: `https://github.com/mohamadkhani/pareto-ai`. The source is a static archive of version v0.1.3, which ensures reproducibility.

The checksum is provided using the b2sum (BLAKE2) algorithm and matches the expected value for the release tarball. This allows verification of the source integrity. All makedepends and depends are standard build and runtime dependencies for a Rust- and Node.js-based desktop application using GTK and WebKit2GTK. There are no signs of obfuscated commands, unauthorized network activity, or suspicious file operations in this metadata file.

As this is a metadata-only file (not an executable script), it cannot perform any actions on its own. It is used by AUR helpers and makepkg to guide the build process. No malicious behavior can be embedded in this format unless paired with a malicious PKGBUILD, but no such file is provided here. The content aligns with standard AUR packaging practices.
